description: Human-authored architectural phase and objective candidates used by the FORGE Governance Synchronizer to generate advisory next-objective recommendations.

phases.title: Deterministic Promotion Evaluation Engine
phases.objective: Evaluate shadow-governance promotion eligibility deterministically while preserving human authority.

phases.title: Deterministic Objective Recommendation Engine
phases.objective: Generate advisory next-objective recommendations from deterministic governance, repository, validation, architectural-progress, and roadmap evidence.

rules: The synchronizer may recommend an objective but may not select, commit, approve, or begin it automatically.
Only human-approved phase definitions and objective candidates may appear in this policy.
Every prerequisite must identify another phase defined in this policy.
A candidate may be recommended only when all listed prerequisites are complete.
Changing this policy does not grant the synchronizer authority to change governance policy.
